Title: NETMESSAGE:Welcome aboard sir.  We are approaching the island now.
Translation: 欢迎登船，先生。我们正在接近岛屿。

Title: NETMESSAGE:It is believed that our lost ship is somewhere deep inland.
Translation: 据信，我们失踪的船就在内陆深处某个地方。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Your mission is to find it.  Good luck.
Translation: 你的任务是找到它。祝你好运。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The way is shut.  You'll have to find another way in.
Translation: 路被封了。你得另找入口。

Title: NETMESSAGE:It's a page from a journal.  It reads?
Translation: 这是日记的一页。上面写着？

Title: NETMESSAGE:An evil has driven us from our main camp.
Translation: 一股邪恶势力将我们赶出了主营地。

Title: NETMESSAGE:We have set up another camp on the south side of the island.
Translation: 我们在岛屿南侧建立了另一个营地。

Title: NETMESSAGE:And buried our treasure along the shore?
Translation: 并把财宝埋在了岸边？

Title: NETMESSAGE:You found the treasure map.
Translation: 你找到了藏宝图。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The treasure is located near a rock on the north side of the island.
Translation: 财宝位于岛屿北侧的一块岩石附近。

Title: NETMESSAGE:This is all that remains of the lost ship's crew.
Translation: 这就是失踪船只船员留下的全部。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You found the treasure!
Translation: 你找到了财宝！

Title: NETMESSAGE:It's another page from the journal.  It reads?
Translation: 这是日记的另一页。上面写着？

Title: NETMESSAGE:Inside this box lies the key to the island.
Translation: 这个盒子里藏着岛屿的钥匙。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Give it to the gatekeeper and you will be let in.
Translation: 把它交给守门人，就会被放行。

Title: NETMESSAGE:An entrance to the island has been unlocked.
Translation: 一个岛屿入口已被解锁。

Title: NETMESSAGE:An entrance has opened on the north side of the island.
Translation: 岛屿北侧的一个入口已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:It's a map to the lost crew's tree house.  Search for it in the northwest.
Translation: 这是失踪船员树屋的地图。在西北方向寻找。

Title: NETMESSAGE:To who ever finds this?
Translation: 致找到此物的人？

Title: NETMESSAGE:If you have come this far then perhaps you are willing to go a little further.
Translation: 如果你已经走到这一步，或许你愿意再往前走一点。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The Dryads know all the island's secrets.  You must speak with the Dryads.
Translation: 树精知道岛屿的所有秘密。你必须和树精交谈。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The ship you seek lies in the depths of the island.
Translation: 你寻找的船就在岛屿深处。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You must reach the highest peak before you can travel to the deep.
Translation: 你必须到达最高峰，才能前往深处。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A passage to the deep has been opened.
Translation: 通往深处的一条通道已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The lost ship has been found!
Translation: 失踪的船已被找到！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The scroll reads....  ARGHHHHHH SHIT LOOKOUT!
Translation: 卷轴上写着.... 啊！！！操，小心！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You win! Good job.
Translation: 你赢了！干得好。

Title: NETMESSAGE:HEY YOU GUYS!
Translation: 嘿，你们几个！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Find the key near the middle of the island to open the captain's quarters.
Translation: 在岛屿中部附近找到钥匙，打开船长室。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Entrance to the West is now open.
Translation: 西侧入口现已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Entrance to the North is now open.
Translation: 北侧入口现已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Entrance to the East is now open.
Translation: 东侧入口现已打开。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Entrance to the South is now open.
Translation: 南侧入口现已打开。
